doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

chapter: Photo session: wagons, parades and goodbyes
title: Milneburg picnic string band and a dated picture
summary: They identify a picnic string band at Milneburg, c. 1899, and a Ursuline and River picture, with debate over its date.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, that's at Millenborg, don't you remember? The picnic at Millenborg?
Yeah, that's a picnic.
The fella's got a bass fiddle there.
Yeah, yeah, yeah.
A guitar and a bass fiddle.
That's right.
Ooh, that's long ago.
Now, we had one like this way out, but a little bit of a top.
Let's see where he is. Here he is, right here.
Like there?
Yeah.
I can see. That would almost...
That must be about...
Yeah.
You know how old that picture would be? About four years, three years old.
Something like that.
What?
The outfit was about four years old.
Three or four years old, yeah. Three or four years old. That picture's about 61 years old or better.

Yeah. You went out at Millenborg. About 1899 or just about the turn of the century. Yeah. With the kids sitting down in front. Yeah. And you had a little bit of kids. Yeah. A bass, a guitar, a mandolin.
Yeah.
That's right before our place. Before our camp.
That's our camp. They had a pig. That fella from over the river. What was his name? Had all them children. His wife and all his children. Oh. Come over there. What was his name?
You, honey, you asked me.
Had they...
I know what you mean.
He had the camp that day.
I know what you mean. Yeah. Here's a picture.
I bet you you wasn't born. You know, I've seen a picture like that on a postcard before. Yeah. Down at the Lugger Landing on the... Oh, good afternoon. Near Esplanade, was that?
Ursuline the River.
Ursuline, yeah. A little bit of...
A little bit of Totman that was taken there.
Don't you remember the boy girls that had two sisters? The daddy. Wasn't it boy from over the river? They had seven or eight kids.
Oh, yeah. I know who you mean now. The old man gives that picnic. Yeah. I know who you mean.
Of course, that's Alfred. That's you and that's me here.
That's Ursuline and the River. Yep.
Copyright 1900, it says. Yeah.
What?
It says copyright 1900 on it. Yeah. But it was... Oh, no.
That was before the 1900. That's just when... The body must have put that there. Yeah. What is that there? I can't see it in my spec.
I can't see it at all. Oh, plus.
Oh, no. That picture was way before the 1900. Oh, look on that. Have you got these names?
